Contact

FLogo Generator is maintained by a single developer, so every message is read directly — there's no support ticket system or automated reply. Pick the category that fits best and write to the address below.

What kind of message is this?

  • General Questions — Anything about how FLogo Generator works or how to use it.
  • Bug Report — Something didn't generate correctly, or the app broke.
  • Feature Request — A platform, option, or icon type you'd like to see added.
  • Privacy Question — Questions about the Privacy Policy or how your data is handled.
  • Advertising — Questions about ads shown on this site.
  • General Feedback — Anything else — good, bad, or just an idea worth sharing.

Email directly

karthik08dev@gmail.com

This is a side project maintained in spare time, so replies aren't instant — but every message does get read. For bug reports, including your browser and the platform(s) you selected helps a lot.
